findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_repo_config" references sensitive artifacts (.env, secret, .npmrc). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Before opening or trusting a GitHub repository someone sent you (a take-home task, a code review, a demo, a fork): its agent configuration can start MCP servers…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "verify_tools" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Checks the tools an agent received from a remote MCP server against alalanet's history of that server, to catch a server that changed its tools after you approv…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
